column1: # VALIDATE check of the PR's .harness/specs/<KEY>/plan.md against the head tree
# and the PR body (file tests, grep and counts; never a shell), and refuse a
# body that says "not met" or misses its `Target metric:`. A body line
# approves in a PR comment (`approve owed: <id>`) excuses the task.
# bin/lib/pr-self-check-validate.sh has the rule. param and match are unused
# (-). Set the mode to note or off to turn the refusal off.

column4: a plan task's static VALIDATE check that fails at the head or in the body, a NOT MET line or a missed Target metric, with no operator-approved owed: line
